text: Discover six mathematics labs from Tecaverso Labs.
Explore geometric shapes and see how their properties appear in three-dimensional models.
Explore functions and graphs. Connect algebraic expressions to the curves they produce.
Investigate probability and statistics. Compare outcomes, distributions, and patterns in data.
On the Cartesian plane, locate points and connect coordinates to their positions.
Explore plane geometry and compare shapes, measurements, and relationships between figures.
With fractions and proportions, compare quantities and identify equivalent relationships.
Learn mathematics interactively with Tecaverso Labs.
